summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Koninklijke Philips NV (Royal Philips) reporting its Q2 2026 quarterly results, dated July 27, 2026. The filing discloses group performance metrics: comparable sales growth of 4% to EUR 4.4 billion, adjusted EBITA margin of 16.4% (including a US tariff refund benefit), and free cash flow of EUR 222 million. It reiterates the full-year comparable sales growth outlook and raises adjusted EBITA and free cash flow guidance to reflect the tariff refund. The filing does not announce any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. It is a routine earnings report, not a special-situation event.
